#!/bin/bash
# Flux job script translated from Slurm

#flux: -c 1
#flux: -p priority
#flux: -t 2-00:00:00

# The Slurm output/error directives are combined into a single output file.
# The '%A' variable is replaced with Flux's '{job.id}'.
#flux: -o logs/rc-nonallelespec/snakemake_{job.id}.log

# CRITICAL: The Slurm memory request '--mem 4G' for the master job was not translated.
# Flux does not have a standard equivalent directive. The job will receive the default memory allocation,
# which may be insufficient and could cause the job to fail.
# #SBATCH --mem 4G

# Ensure the log directory exists
mkdir -p logs/rc-nonallelespec

module unload python
module load gcc conda2 slurm-drmaa/1.1.1
conda activate rctest

# WARNING: The '--drmaa' arguments have been translated from Slurm to Flux.
# This requires a correctly configured Snakemake DRMAA profile for Flux.
# CRITICAL: Slurm's memory request ('--mem={cluster.mem}') has no standard Flux equivalent and has been OMITTED.
# All sub-jobs will get default memory, which will likely cause many of them to fail.
drmaa_args=' -c {cluster.cores} -q {cluster.partition} -t {cluster.time} -o {cluster.out} -J {cluster.J} '

snakemake \
  --snakefile src/20_62_nonallelespec_rc-test-Snakefile.py \
  --jobs 9980 \
  --restart-times 0 \
  --cluster-config config/rc-test-snakemake-cluster.json \
  --latency-wait 120 \
  --drmaa "$drmaa_args"

conda deactivate

issues: CRITICAL: As noted in the script's comments, the original Slurm memory request (`--mem 4G`) for the main control job was omitted. The job will receive a default, smaller memory allocation and is likely to fail if the main snakemake process requires more memory.

CRITICAL: The memory request (`--mem={cluster.mem}`) for the sub-jobs submitted by Snakemake has been omitted from the `--drmaa` arguments. This is the most severe issue, as it means all jobs submitted by the workflow will receive the system's default memory allocation. This is highly likely to be insufficient and will cause many of the workflow's steps to fail.

The script loads a module named `slurm-drmaa`. This module is specific to the Slurm environment and will likely not be available or functional in a Flux environment. A Flux-specific DRMAA implementation would be required for the `--drmaa` flag to work, and the `module load` line would need to be changed accordingly.

  --snakefile src/20_62_nonallelespec_rc-test-Snakefile.py \
  --jobs 9980 \
  --restart-times 0 \
  --cluster-config config/rc-test-snakemake-cluster.json \
